finalText:
Perfect! All tests are now passing. The bug was a boundary condition error in the `isExpired` function—it was using `<` instead of `<=` when checking if a token has expired. This allowed tokens to remain valid for an extra instant after their expiration time was reached.

The fix ensures that tokens are rejected the exact moment their expiration time is reached, which matches both the comment specification and all test expectations. All 5 tests now pass.
